All three questions are answered and `answer.json` is written to the working directory in the required dict-of-dicts format, with every employee ID validated against the employee directory.

**How I got there:** Each product file's documents use an internal codename for the product (CoachForce → "CoFoAIX", PersonalizeForce → "onalizeAIX"/Einstein Adaptive Personalization), grounded by the product's planning channels inside the same file. A global sweep confirmed no other file contains CoachForce artifacts, so there was no cross-product leakage.

**q1 — Authors and key reviewers of the CoachForce Market Research Report** (doc `latest_cofoaix_market_research_report`, the newest of the three versions): the author is `eid_890654c4` (Julia Smith, Marketing Research Analyst), and the key reviewers are the 7 participants of the review meeting `CoFoAIX_planning_1` — each of whom gave concrete feedback in the transcript (not just attendance): `eid_99835861`, `eid_50da4819`, `eid_ee9ca887`, `eid_8df92d08`, `eid_85a4de81`, `eid_965867b8`, `eid_59bbe6f6`. The report-share slack messages had no thread replies, so the review meeting is the sole reviewer evidence.

**q2 — Team members who provided strengths/weaknesses insights on PersonalizeForce's competitors** (TailorAI, PersonaAI, SmartSuggest): five members posted substantive competitor analysis — `eid_5318af37` (TailorAI strengths, SmartSuggest weaknesses), `eid_fce6544f` (PersonaAI weaknesses), `eid_c9c3d8d5` (SmartSuggest strengths), `eid_d2f0f99a` (PersonaAI strengths and weaknesses), and `eid_a253c65a` (TailorAI strengths and weaknesses). Members who only asked questions or said "thanks for the insights" were excluded.

**q3 — Demo URLs shared for competitor products:** `https://personaai.com/demo`, `https://smartsuggest.com/demo`, and `https://tailorai.com/demo`. The six `sf-internal.slack.com/archives/PersonalizeForce/demo_*` links were excluded because they are PersonalizeForce's own product demos, not competitors'.

One caveat: the "tokens" fields are estimates of the analysis effort per question, since exact per-question token accounting isn't exposed by the harness.
